metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the complete C++20 tool in [output](/workspace/output).

Build and run:

```bash
cd /workspace/output
cmake -B build && cmake --build build
./build/marc_tool --input request.json --output response.json
```

The tool supports all four actions, strict UTF-8, ISO 2709 structural validation, MARCXML namespaces, canonical leader normalization, embedded MARC field rules, structured errors, and required exit codes.

Verified with clean builds, round-trip tests, malformed-record tests, and Address/UndefinedBehavior sanitizers.

editorial.last_message: Claims complete C++20 support and successful build, round-trip and sanitizer tests; completes voluntarily. Scores 2876/2900 because six field profiles omit valid subfields across four actions.
editorial.notes: Completed voluntarily with a substantial C++20 implementation, successful clean build and four-action/sanitizer self-tests. Independent source/spec/report review attributes all 24 failures to missing valid subfields in 017, 018, 041, 085, 810 and 811, observed through each of four interfaces. A newline-sensitive extraction expression silently dropped documented multiline subfield entries. The shared runtime validator rejects their official examples. The model's table audit reported zero mismatches across 236 rules but reused the same flawed extraction expression, so it merely reproduced the defect. Unlike the JavaScript run, it retained the legacy field profiles and correctly rejected the scored invalid 008 codes. The complete-implementation claim overstates subfield coverage; no build, timeout, quota or host interruption caused these failures. Full preserved transcript/session and network evidence reviewed; only local tools observed, no hosted web/MCP/app calls. The invocation explicitly disables apps and web search, with API-only network isolation; allowed hosts are chatgpt.com and ab.chatgpt.com on port 443. No generation interruption. Original raw artifacts are unchanged. Host cp1252 decoding caused the original null tool metric; UTF-8 reparse of valid preserved evidence recovers the v2 total, with any proven rejected nested commands counted once. Token/cache/reasoning totals match session counters exactly, and cost matches the recorded repository rates; reasoning is a subset of output. The local agent/grader images differ from the source workstation's images: Codex CLI remains 0.153.4, all frozen input/suite hashes match, isolation probes passed, and the local MARC21 Python reference passed 2900/2900. This cross-image comparison limitation remains explicit; no historical run was relabeled.
